subtitle: A walled village of gallows and crypts beside the Whispering Wood
canonNote: Canon (Khaven Village map): walled village with the Cracked Hearth, two Fallen Smithies, the Blood-Stone Well, the Gallows Tree and the Crypt-Keeper's Hovel; the Whispering Wood to the west, Gloom Creek, and the Carrion Cliffs. GAME-ONLY / PROVISIONAL: the Sandthrone outriders holding it, the Pale watcher at the crypt, the crypt itself, road links to Oakhaven and all exact placement. Also GAME-ONLY: the wilderness beyond the walls (the deep Whispering Wood, the north road to the Peaks, the drowned graveyard and creek barrow), the levelling camps, and the residents Wenna Coyle, Ansel Morrow and Cato Brisk. Hollow Men are a CANON creature (book1 ch.4); their presence here is GAME-ONLY. The 340 m growth (2026-09-30) adds, all GAME-ONLY in placement and story: the Hush and the Listener's Hut deeper in the Whispering Wood (the Listener is a Silent Pilgrim; the Silent Pilgrims are CANON), the corpse road with its coffin stones and bridge, the gibbet crossroads on the Gloom road, the plague pit, the drowned fields, the Carrion Heights and the Charnel Barrow above the Carrion Cliffs (the cliffs are CANON), the Old Bound Wall and the Fallen Watch on the north road, and the Pale Reckoner (the Pale Things are CANON).
worldMapNote: Position provisional: canon gives no location; placed west of Oakhaven because the roads connect.
objectives: Arm yourself with a recovered blade [I]

exits.name: North road to the Shattered Peaks

landmarks.name: Blood-Stone Well
landmarks.text: Scrubbed every morning. Still red by noon.

landmarks.name: The Gallows Tree
landmarks.text: Nobody remembers who planted it. Everyone remembers who hung there.

landmarks.name: The Cracked Hearth
landmarks.text: The fire has not gone out in living memory.

landmarks.name: The Whispering Wood
landmarks.text: Grey trunks that talk when the wind stops.

landmarks.name: The north road
landmarks.text: Hoofprints, baked hard, going north toward the Peaks.

landmarks.name: Deep Whispering Wood
landmarks.text: Past the walls the grey trunks crowd close enough to touch.

landmarks.name: Carrion Cliffs
landmarks.text: Something always circles overhead.

landmarks.name: Drowned graveyard
landmarks.text: When the creek floods, it takes the low graves.

landmarks.name: Creek barrow
landmarks.text: Old Hobb Garner asked to be buried with his spade.

landmarks.name: Outrider camp
landmarks.text: Sandthrone tents of a sort, and everything they 'tolled' off Khaven.

landmarks.name: The Gibbet Crossroads
landmarks.text: Khaven buries its hanged where four roads meet, so they can't find the way home.
landmarks.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the crossroads, its gibbet and the crossroads burials (the world bible asks for burial customs).

landmarks.name: The Corpse Road
landmarks.text: The wood steadings carried their dead out this way. The bearers rested the coffins on the stones.

landmarks.name: The Plague Pit
landmarks.text: The fever year filled it in a month. Nothing grows on it, and nobody asks it to.

landmarks.name: The Drowned Fields
landmarks.text: Barley ground once. Every flood takes a little more of it and gives back mud.
landmarks.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the fields. Gloom Creek is CANON (the Khaven village map).

landmarks.name: The Carrion Heights
landmarks.text: The crows sit up here in rows and watch the creek for whatever it brings down.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Carrion Cliffs are CANON (the Khaven village map); the heights above them are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Charnel Barrow
landmarks.text: When the creek took the low graves, Khaven carried the bones up here, above any flood.

landmarks.name: The Old Bound Wall
landmarks.text: Khaven walled all of this once, when it had more worth walling in.

landmarks.name: The Fallen Watch
landmarks.text: The north watch-tower came down in a gale. The Sandthrone like what is left of it for a windbreak.
landmarks.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the tower. The Sandthrone are a CANON mercenary company; their picket here is GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Listener's Hut
landmarks.text: A Silent Pilgrim came to hear what the wood says. The lamp still lights itself at dusk.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Pilgrims are CANON (world_bible.md); the Listener and his hut are GAME-ONLY.

landmarks.name: The Hush
landmarks.text: The trunks crowd too close for any wind. Here even the Whispering Wood keeps quiet.
landmarks.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Whispering Wood is CANON (the Khaven village map); the Hush is GAME-ONLY.

camps.name: Gloom Creek hollows
camps.canonStatus: CANON creature (Hollow Men, book1 ch.4), GAME-ONLY placement

camps.name: Plague pit hollows
camps.canonStatus: CANON creature (Hollow Men, book1 ch.4), GAME-ONLY placement

camps.name: The Pale Reckoner
camps.canonStatus: CANON creature (the Pale Things as cosmic auditors, world_bible.md), GAME-ONLY character

secrets.name: The Old Beacon
secrets.text: Fire-cracked stones ring the crown of the mound where Khaven once lit its beacon. From up here the village sits in its dusk: the red well, the gallows, the split chimney glowing.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the mound and its beacon. The Blood-Stone Well, the Gallows Tree and the Cracked Hearth are CANON (the Khaven village map).

secrets.name: A Key Under the Gallows
secrets.text: A brass key on a greasy thong, hung from a nail under the gallows boards, where no one in Khaven will put a hand. Desert brass. Not a village key.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the key and its owner. The Sandthrone is a CANON mercenary company; its hold on Khaven is GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: The Outrider's Hoard
secrets.prompt: Open the banded box under the log
secrets.text: An iron-banded box tucked in against a fallen grey trunk, deep where the wood talks. The brass key turns stiffly. Inside is an outrider's private share of Khaven's 'toll', and his tally of it.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the hoard, the knife and the tally. The Sandthrone is CANON; its hold on Khaven is GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: A Page from the Sexton's Register
secrets.prompt: Tease the page out of the wall
secrets.text: A page torn from the sexton's register, folded into a crack in the drowned chapel's wall and gone soft with damp. Most of it still reads.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the register, its names and the salt custom. Hollow Men are a CANON creature (book1 ch.4).

secrets.name: Widow's-Lamps
secrets.text: Pale bells no bigger than a thumbnail, lit from inside like lamps left in a window. Khaven calls them widow's-lamps and won't pick them after dark.

secrets.name: Where the Crows Wait
secrets.text: A cairn of skull-sized stones on the lip of the Carrion Heights, where the crows sit in rows and wait. The old cliffs break out of the scrub below, Gloom Creek runs dull as lead past their feet, and somewhere west in the murk lies Khaven, keeping its lamps lit.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the heights and the cairn. The Carrion Cliffs and Gloom Creek are CANON (the Khaven village map).

secrets.name: The Listener's Daybook
secrets.prompt: Work the folded page out of the chink in the wall
secrets.text: Leaves of a daybook, folded small and pushed into a chink in the hut wall where the damp couldn't reach them. The hand is careful, then less careful.
secrets.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Pilgrims and their 'Original Song' are CANON, and so are the Pale Things as cosmic auditors (world_bible.md); the Listener and his daybook are GAME-ONLY.

secrets.name: Coins for the Hanged
secrets.prompt: Lift the flat stone at the foot of the crossroads grave
secrets.text: Travellers on the Gloom road leave a coin under the stone for the hanged, so the hanged won't follow them home. Nobody in Khaven would take one back. There is a tin under there, heavy with years of them, and a draught somebody left for the same reason.
secrets.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the crossroads burial and the coin custom.
